STYLISH DESIGN: Featuring chic Bow, Cloud, Flower, and Checkboard patterns, this aesthetic pet bed doubles your apartment vibe. It’s a cozy, fashionable retreat-perfect as a cat gift, dog gift, or for your furry friend's special day as a dog birthday gift
SUPPORTIVE STRUCTURE: Raised bolstered edges create a sense of security while providing perfect head support, and the foam-filled center offers firm cushioning that won't flatten with use

NON-SLIP SECURITY: Comfort dog bed features anti-slip dots on bottom to prevent sliding on hardwood or tile floors. The stable base ensures the bed stays in place during your pet's movements, providing safety and stability

authors_reviews.title: Plush Beautiful Donut Pet Bed
authors_reviews.text: This is a simple to put together donut pet bed. The pillow part is full and plump. The cover part is very good quality fabric and zipper in a super cute flower print. The fur is very plush. I got the medium. It is huge. My 17# frenchie can stretch completely out and barely touch the sides. There is black fabric with non slip dots on the bottom of the circular center pillow. My dog loves this bed. It took her a few days to get used to it. It keeps her warm in a very cool room. It is a little pricey compared to other donut beds but the quality is there so i feel like this bed is worth it.
authors_reviews.author: Shineythings

authors_reviews.title: Both Doggo and her Human love it. [Update after 1 year]
authors_reviews.text: Doggo: 36lb KVD (Jindo/Akita)Bed: Clouds LTime owned when reviewed: 1 monthOverview: Dog's new favorite, so far quite durable, easy to put together/dismantle for cleaning, cute and not an eyesore in the living room.Full Review:I honestly bought this on a whim after I'd been looking at it for a while. She has enough beds but it's so cute. My excuse was that she likes to curl up but all her current beds were rectangular, for splaying out, so she needed to try this round bed for curling. She's also a big fan of bolsters on beds so this would be right up her alley. Yeah, now I HAVE to buy it! So I did.It did appear a slight bit mishappen/lumpy after first putting it together. Nothing drastic but it did just need a bit of time to settle. I massaged it just a little bit at first, then also moved it around the room a couple times over the next few days to find a good spot for it and it evened out. Then more so after she'd used it.She actually didn't touch it at first. I'd lure her on it with a treat and she'd leave immediately after. New things are weird. But then one day she just decided it was her favorite bed. She's now completely stopped using the other (rectangular) bed in this room. She loves to "bury" things in the crevice and play with toys on it as well, something she never does on her other beds. This also means she scratches at it A LOT and it's held up pretty well so far. Her claws don't snag or tear the fabric or anything. We'll see how that goes over time.I've yet to wash it but seems like it'd be a breeze, logistically, based on how easy it was to put together. Just unzip, remove cover, clean, zip back up. If I have any issues with durability after the first wash, I'll update.---------------------UPDATE: June 2025 (1 year later)This has been an amazing bed. Not just because my pup likes it and uses it a lot but also because she's absolutely assaulted it and I'm very, very impressed with how it's held up. I'm buying more for other rooms (and perhaps will also replace the first one for aesthetics even though it doesn't really need it).WASHING: Very easy to disassemble/reassemble and has washed great with no issues.DURABILITY: So her scratching of the bed I mentioned before when she would "bury" things had no effect for about 5 months, even with her long, sharp nails. Not even lose threads from the plush/shag. HOWEVER, we took a road trip to grandmas and were there for about 2 months... where, in the dirt section of the back yard there, she learned she absolutely loves to dig frantically for minutes at a time. When we got back home, she chose this bed to mimic that behavior hahaha. She's allowed to destroy some things so I let this bed one of them to give her a place to let out the digging behavior. I assumed the bed would be in pieces rather quickly since she'd spend 2-3 minutes solid at a time just digging as fast as she could in the center of the bed, about 2-3 times a day. It did affect the bed, of course; how could it not! But it's held up *surprisingly well*. She did this for a little over a month before she calmed down a bit (and is back to only scratching/digging in very brief sessions a few times a week). In that time, she pulled out a lot of the plush threads there so that the cover is pretty bare now. No shag and just the flat fabric underneath. But there's only one small hole in the cover there where she really wore it down. I'm shocked. I expected many tears, even through to the padding underneath but nope. Obviously that middle part doesn't look pretty when she's not in it so I am debating on whether to replace it, but I don't *need* to. She still lays on it and the padding is just fine, her occasional scratching/digging hasn't affected it any further (though I'm sure it will over time since there's a hole already started now), and the outside bolster ring is still as pristine as ever.All doggos are different, of course, but I classify her treatment of it as "extreme" for that solid month+ and "tough" on it normally so if your dog is below that, I would venture to say this bed will hold up.Note that she has not chewed it! She did try when we first got it but I indicated to her that was not allowed so she hasn't attempted since. (She's allowed other things to destroy via chewing.) So I don't know how it'd hold up if your pup is a rogue chewer!I should probably also note that she doesn't do this with any other bed she has so I don't have anything to compare durability to under the same kind of treatment. (This is the only shaggy-style bed she has so maybe that triggers it in her too?)
authors_reviews.author: House of Brynn

authors_reviews.title: Assembly a bit difficult, but good quality and cute
authors_reviews.text: When I received this item and it was unassembled, I immediately had doubts as to whether or not it would be good quality. So I opened everything up and tried to fluff up the donut ring and allow it to reconstitute. I said the little Center pad in the middle on the floor, and one of my kitties was sleeping in it right away, even without the cover! One nice thing about the cover being separate is that I could wash it before putting it on. Inserting the center pillow into the bottom of the cover was easy, but the outer donut part was a little more difficult. I had a difficult time getting the zipper to line up at the bottom so that I could start zipping. Also, once I got to the last maybe five or six inches, I had to really work to stuff the donut into the cover to make it fit. Once everything was finished though, it's a nice, firm but soft cat bed that I think is going to hold up for quite some time. Although I do have to say that unless the cover get something really nasty on it, I will probably not take it off and wash it. It's too much of a struggle to put it on. All of that being said, it does seem to be a good quality so far. And very cute!
authors_reviews.author: freeindeed07

authors_reviews.title: BEST DOGGY BED EVER!!
authors_reviews.text: This is HANDS DOWN the best dog bed I have ever bought my girl Bean. It’s absolutely adorable but the material is so soft, almost minky textured. The amount of memory foam makes this an extremely supportive & comfortable bed for my girl who is going on 10. I was a little worried it might be kind of pain to put together & it was an absolute breeze. I had to keep telling my dog to wait because she wanted to immediately get in it lol. Then once it was fully put together she never got out of it the rest of the night - it kinda bummed her dog dad out but this bed was just so quality in every way I was so happy she loved it. I will suggest it to all my other dog owner homies & family. If you’re on the fence - just buy it. You won’t regret it.
authors_reviews.author: Brandy R

authors_reviews.title: Snuggly large dog bed
authors_reviews.text: ***Edited to add, my slightly smaller dog - a heeler mix (65 lbs) finally used the bed and I realizedi could have gotten a medium. Just for anyone torn between sizes.***I've been wanting a cuddler bed for my dog for a long time and saw a reel with a larger dog using this one so I had to check it out.The cover is soft and I love the cloud pattern. And my tall, muscular, 85lb lab fits well in it. My other dog hasn't tried it out yet, but it's only been a few days.There was no weird smell and set up wasn't too difficult. It arrived vacuum sealed and it was a bit challenging spreading out the foam so that it fluffed up evenly. The zipper was a pain in the butt, but once I got it going, it came together nicely.I only have 4 stars because it's a lot heavier than anticipated and the center is fluffier than I wanted it to be. I had to sit on it a few times to get it to smoosh down enough for the dogs to be comfortable.Overall it's a nice, snuggly bed for bigger dogs.
authors_reviews.author: Ms Morghan

other_countries_reviews.title: Great size and very comfortable!
other_countries_reviews.text: My standard poodle *LOVES* this bed!! I was hesitant because of the high price and it sat in my cart for quite a while, but I’m so glad I made this purchase!It matches my bed blanket perfectly. My dog is blind and needed something donut shaped to snuggle into that was big enough for him. At first I was hesitant as the shrink wrapping made the foam seem hard and uncomfortable but after breaking it up a bit with my hands and giving it a couple hours to expand it exceeded all my expectations in comfort and plush. My poodle is about 65lbs and fits nicely in this donut bed and as mentioned, he absolutely LOVES it.I ordered the largest size and am very pleased to note that the cover is removable for washing. The stitching and fabric quality are fantastic and there were no weird foam smells from it or anything like that. My dog immediately took to this and snuggled in and I’ve even sat on it to try it out as well. Very comfortable and well made.The only downside is the price is quite high on this item but I have a feeling it will last a long time. I would definitely recommend this pet bed.
